newsitem.title: USA: GT Global Eastern Europe to prorate buyback.
newsitem.headline: GT Global Eastern Europe to prorate buyback.

text.p: G.T. Global Eastern Europe Fund said it will prorate the repurchases to be made under its annual share buyback plan after investors tendered more shares than the fund had offered to buy back.
The fund said about 3,241,528 shares or 45 percent of its shares outstanding were validly tendered and not withdrawn prior to the April 18 expiration of the repurchase offer.
The closed-end fund had offered to repurchase five percent of its outstanding shares.

The shares will be repurchased for cash at a price equal to their net asset value as of the close of regular trading on the New York Stock Exchange on May 2, 1997, subject to a fee of no more than two percent of net asset value per share, which will be deducted from the price, it said.

It said the number of shares tendered is subject to final confirmation and the proper delivery of all shares tendered and not withdrawn, including shares tendered pursuant to the guaranteed delivery procedure. It estimated 31,362 shares are subject to the guarantee.
